answer: Spectral analysis at the kernel: each identity's wallet graph is embedded and the second eigenvalue of its Laplacian exposes tightly clustered sybil rings. The beacon periodically re-samples edges, so fake links decay and clusters must be rebuilt. A reef of honest wallets separates communities, forcing attackers to bridge real users at high cost. Break-even: buying k identities needs O(k²) genuine edges, making farms unprofitable past roughly 8 wallets.
